nom: celimax Dual Barrier Purifying Cleansing Balm

avis.titre: Best cleansing balm I've ever tried!
avis.texte: I have dry, reactive, acne-prone skin. I've tried 5+ cleansing balms, and this is the only one that fully emulsifies with water and rinses completely without a cloth or a lot of rubbing. Leaves my skin clean without irritation or breakouts.
I got this on a whim along with the dual barrier toner, serum, gel cleanser & wearable cream. I'm so glad I did because it's really helped keep my skin supple & hydrated!
